literal.prompt: Какой из этих материков получает в среднем меньше всего осадков за год?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The actual answer category is now four continent names; the player must know the geographic precipitation ranking. AAP explicitly identifies Antarctica as the driest continent. Geoscience Australia and the Australian Bureau of Meteorology establish Australia as a plausible close runner-up (the driest other/inhabited continent); the remaining three are actual continents, with their retained note facts verified below. Thus Antarctica is the unique key at frozen index2 without a category or lexical match.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic weather L299,L344-L349; Geoscience Australia L13-L18; BOM L4-L17.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктида получает меньше осадков, чем любой другой материк. На высоком полярном плато годовое накопление снега в водном эквиваленте составляет менее 50 мм.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP identifies Antarctica as the driest continent, estimates continent-wide annual snow accumulation as 150 mm water equivalent and the elevated plateau at less than 50 mm. BAS independently reports the Antarctic interior as about 50 mm water equivalent annually.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic weather L299,L344-L349; BAS Weather in the Antarctic L4.

literalGroups.literal: Австралийские пустыни занимают около 18% материка; Австралию вместе с Антарктидой относят к двум самым сухим континентам.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Geoscience Australia says Australia and Antarctica are the world’s two driest continents; it lists mainland Australian deserts as 18% of Australia. The Australian Bureau of Meteorology independently says Australia is the driest continent except Antarctica and reports 460 mm mean annual precipitation.

literalGroups.literal: Сахара на севере Африки — крупнейшая жаркая пустыня мира; она простирается через 11 стран.
literalGroups.primaryGround: UNEP places the Sahara in North Africa, identifies it as the largest hot desert, and says it crosses 11 countries. NASA independently locates the Sahara across the northern half of Africa.
literalGroups.locator: UNEP Desert Journey L115-L123; NASA African Dust L0-L3.

literalGroups.literal: На высоком полярном плато годовое накопление снега в водном эквиваленте составляет менее 50 мм.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP says average annual snow accumulation over the elevated Antarctic plateau is below 50 mm water equivalent. BAS independently states the inland receives approximately 50 mm water equivalent annually.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic weather L344-L349; BAS Weather in the Antarctic L4.

literalGroups.literal: Амазония — крупнейший в мире биом: она занимает около 40% Южной Америки и охватывает девять стран.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NASA states the Amazon rainforest extends over about 40% of South America and spans eight countries plus French Guiana. The Brazilian biodiversity agency says Amazonia is the world’s largest biome and includes nine countries.
literalGroups.locator: NASA MODIS L65-L73; ICMBio Amazônia L316-L323.
